listings.title: Studio in Westlands, walk to Sarit
listings.summary: Furnished studio, backup power, secure parking.
listings.description: A furnished studio on the third floor of a quiet block off Church Road, five minutes' walk from Sarit Centre. Borehole water, backup generator, lift serviced monthly, and 24-hour manned gate.

listings.title: Two-bed apartment, Kileleshwa
listings.summary: Corner unit with a balcony over the gardens.
listings.description: A bright two-bedroom corner apartment with a wrap-around balcony overlooking mature gardens. Fitted kitchen, master en-suite, borehole water and a generator covering the whole block.

listings.title: Beach cottage, Diani
listings.summary: Two minutes from the sand, under the palms.
listings.description: A thatched two-bedroom cottage set back from Diani beach road, with an outdoor shower, a shaded veranda and a short path through the palms to the sand. Breakfast can be arranged.

listings.title: Sea-view apartment, Nyali
listings.description: A one-bedroom apartment on the fourth floor with an unbroken view over the channel. Pool and secure parking in the block; the beach is a ten-minute walk.

listings.title: Family house with garden, Karen
listings.summary: Half an acre, mature trees, staff quarters.
listings.description: A five-bedroom family house on half an acre in Karen, with mature indigenous trees, a borehole, solar water heating, staff quarters and a double garage. Title deed ready.

listings.title: Serviced apartment, Upper Hill
listings.summary: Weekly housekeeping, walk to the hospitals.
listings.description: A serviced two-bedroom apartment among the Upper Hill offices, with weekly housekeeping, a gym in the building and fibre throughout. Convenient for the hospitals and the CBD.

listings.title: Townhouse in Nyali, three bed
listings.summary: Gated court of eight, shared pool.
listings.description: A three-bedroom townhouse in a gated court of eight units off Links Road, sharing a pool and a generator. All bedrooms en-suite, with a small private garden behind.

listings.title: One-bed in Kilimani, furnished
listings.description: A furnished one-bedroom for short stays, five minutes from Yaya Centre. Fast fibre, a proper desk, and a lift that works.
